outcome: Temp roots stop accumulating forever: the driver factory sweeps stale certification roots at construction in the proven native-session reaper pattern, so a run that dies without unwinding no longer leaves its sworn-driver-certification root behind permanently, and the one gitx temp site cleaned by per-return removes becomes a defer so a panic cannot leak it.

exclude: the native-session reaper itself (reapNativeSessionRoots and its guards are the pattern to copy, not a surface to change)
in-process defer cleanup at the other temp sites (invocation-scratch, inputs, capture, git-index/context/home dirs already clean up in-process; cross-process sweeps for them are out of scope)
Close() semantics (the factory's existing cleanup contract is unchanged)

acceptance.text: The driver factory reaps its own stale roots: NewProductionDriverFactory (internal/driver/factory.go:35) mints sworn-driver-certification-v1-* under the temp root at :51 with nested workspace-* dirs (:204), and the only cleanup is Close() (:116, sync.Once + RemoveAll at :120-127) - nothing runs under SIGKILL/OOM/reboot, hence the hundreds of empty leaked roots in sworn#194. After this slice, construction sweeps stale prior roots before minting its own, copying the reapNativeSessionRoots shape (internal/driver/native_linux.go:820, invoked at construction :438): prefix match, uid ownership, non-symlink directory, age guard against a lifetime (staleNativeSessionRoot :883, validNativeSessionRoot :892 are the guard patterns), with unremovable roots handled without failing construction. Pinned by tests over a stale root, a fresh root, a foreign-owned root, and a symlink.

ApplyRefTransaction cannot leak by panic: internal/gitx/refs.go:594 mints sworn-ref-transaction-* and cleans it by explicit removes on three exits (:599, :603, :610) - any other return or a panic between :594 and :610 leaks the directory, in contrast to the adjacent defer cancel() at :583. After this slice the cleanup is a single defer with the existing subordinate-error semantics (:629's inert-cleanup stance) preserved. Pinned by the existing suite staying green plus a test or review evidence that every exit path is covered by the defer.

constraints: The reaper must never touch a root it cannot prove is sworn's and stale: prefix, same-uid ownership, non-symlink shape, and an age floor are all required, in the spirit of validNativeSessionRoot; when in doubt, leave it.

Certification roots have no lease file; the liveness guard is the age floor plus ownership - the reaper must be conservative enough that a concurrently constructing factory's fresh root is never swept.

A reap failure degrades, never detonates: construction proceeds when a stale root resists removal (parking or skipping is acceptable); the factory's own root lifecycle and Close() behavior are unchanged.
This is the release's smallest slice by design; no scope growth into the defer-cleaned temp sites listed in the exclusions.
Check evidence belongs in the submission's checks field, never in files added to the repository.
